{{Quote|When I'm done, you'll be nothing but ashes!|Sogan Sur|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Sogan Sur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] criminal who was a henchman of a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A red-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], Sur carried two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] in combat, and his lieutenants were known as "Razor Ghouls."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sogan Sur appears as one of the possible Henchmen Bounties in the Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. Sur can be summoned by using Rendezvous Beacon F-46, which appears on the planets [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and [[Voss]]. The player has the option to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him or capture him alive with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so as a result, this article refrains from assuming which crime lord he worked for, where he was encountered, and his fate. Sur's armor was later released on the Cartel Market.<ref name="TOR" />
